newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight - New orders cited but rates ease.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight - New orders cited but rates ease.

text.p: A handful of orders were quoted in Monday's routine sugar freight business but rates continued to soften in line with the overall freight market, shipbrokers said.

E.D.&F. Man brought three new orders. These were a 14,000-tonne bagged cargo for early February from Veracruz to Colombo option Dubai, another from Acajutla to the Red Sea option to Colombo 12,000 to 16,000 tonnes for 6-10 February and Santander to Jeddah 8,000 tonnes for 1-15 February.

Elsewhere, Nissho Eyiwai were in the market for 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar from Cuba to Japan for March, and Czarnikow-Rionda were quoting Puerto Quetzal-West Africa 12,000 tonnes bagged for early February.
Bosco were open for 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar from the European Union excluding the UK to Iran from 15 February onwards.
